build_cutmix_augmentation: build a python module that applies CutMix batch augmentation to a batch of images and labels
create_cutmix_instance: create a CutMix instance with alpha parameter and optional cutmix_minmax bounds for data augmentation
test_rand_bbox_minmax: test the rand_bbox_minmax method to generate random rectangular bounding boxes within min/max area ratios
test_rand_bbox: test the rand_bbox method to generate random square bounding boxes based on a lambda value
test_mix: test the mix method that cuts and pastes patches among training images and mixes labels proportionally
